implementation_notice: Independent implementation with explicit protocols; not an exact reproduction of undisclosed author evaluation code.

notes: Independent implementation; source-paper evaluator equivalence is not established.
HD95 follows the package-wide surface-distance 0.1 protocol: surfel-area-weighted directional 95th percentiles, then their maximum.
BC_proxy and SL_voxels_proxy use native-grid Lee skeletonization; no resampling is performed.
The paper standardizes to 334/512 x 334/512 x 1.00 mm and uses an octree-based skeleton method; these proxies are not paper-exact BC/SL.
SL_voxels_proxy counts skeleton voxels, not physical millimetres; compare only on explicitly matched grids.
BC/SL ratios are abundance ratios, not matched-branch recall; excess branches or length do not establish better segmentation.
MCS uses the printed numerator divided by predicted-plus-reference vascular voxel counts; no factor of two is added. Complete A/V swapping gives 0.5.
AUC uses only separately supplied probability maps, one-vs-rest per case; no AUC is inferred from hard labels.
The paper's expert reader scores require human review and are not automated by this evaluator.

protocol.implementation: independent; hard-label metrics plus explicitly named native-grid skeleton proxies
protocol.geometry_requirement: same shape, shared aligned orthogonal voxel grid; affine agreement must be checked by caller
protocol.fraction_scale: 0 to 1, not percent; MCS printed-formula interpretation is 0 to 0.5
protocol.FPR: FP/(FP+TN) = 1-SPE; negatives are one-vs-rest within the confusion-count scope
protocol.HD95: surface-distance 0.1; surfel-area-weighted 95th percentile in each direction, then maximum, in mm
protocol.HD95_caveat: unified package convention; the paper's exact surface implementation was not verified
protocol.empty_DSC: both empty: None; exactly one empty: 0
protocol.empty_HD95: None if either surface is empty
protocol.undefined_denominator: None, with per-metric status; not replaced by zero or infinity
protocol.MCS: (|P_A intersect G_V| + |P_V intersect G_A|) / (|P_A union P_V| + |G_A union G_V|)
protocol.MCS_caveat: literal printed P+T denominator interpreted as total predicted plus reference vascular counts; official evaluator not verified
protocol.skeletonization: scikit-image skeletonize(method='lee'), no pruning or component removal
protocol.BC_proxy: 26-connected component count of skeleton voxels with 26-neighbour degree >=3
protocol.SL_voxels_proxy: number of foreground skeleton voxels, not length in mm
protocol.proxy_ratio: prediction count / reference count; undefined when reference count is zero; not branch matching recall
protocol.resampling: none; original paper's standardized grid is not silently applied
protocol.AUC: per-case one-vs-rest Mann-Whitney U/(n_positive*n_negative), scipy rankdata average ties; no hard-label substitution
protocol.AUC_pooling_caveat: author cohort-level ROC pooling/aggregation was not verified; this implementation returns per-case AUC

comparison_rule: Deltas are after minus before. Counts and count ratios do not by themselves establish segmentation accuracy.
